before.note: the development set; resolves torch to the default PyPI build, which bundles CUDA
before.also_includes: a C++ build toolchain (build-essential). requirements.txt pins fasttext==0.9.3, which publishes no wheel for CPython 3.12, so the naive image cannot be built without a compiler. Part of the saving below is therefore the toolchain and not torch — though the CUDA stack is the larger share by roughly an order of magnitude.

after.note: runtime only, CPU-only torch wheel from the PyTorch index, installed with --no-cache-dir

method: both images built from this repository's Dockerfile, differing only in the requirements file installed; sizes from `docker image inspect --format {{.Size}}`
